verify.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import collections, hashlib, json

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
s=json.loads((p/'seal.json').read_text())
for f in s['sources']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((Path(s['root'])/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']
reports=[json.loads((p/'benchmark'/stage/'development/report.json').read_text()) for stage in ['reference','pooled','resumed']]
epochs=[[(r['caseId'],r['arm'],r['execution']['outcome']) for r in report['rows']] for report in reports]
assert epochs[0]==epochs[1]==epochs[2]
rows=reports[0]['rows']; assert len(rows)==84
baseline={x['caseId']:x['outcome'] for x in json.loads((p/'baseline-controls.json').read_text())}
extra=['leftSetupBudget','rightSetupBudget','leftSetupSpend','rightSetupSpend','observedLiveRandomDraws','deliveryPreviewCalls','catalogCalls','prunedDeliveryPlans','previewRngUuidChecks']
def native(outcome):
    v=json.loads(json.dumps(outcome))
    for k in extra: del v['diagnostics'][k]
    del v['evidence']['sniperDonorObservation']
    return v
def amounts(outcome):
    c=collections.Counter()
    for unit in outcome['evidence']['opening']['units']: c[unit['team'],unit['creatureId']]+=unit['amountAlive']
    return c
scores=collections.Counter(); controls=0; pruned=0; changed=[]; gains=losses=0; by_case=[]
for case in sorted({r['caseId'] for r in rows}):
    arms={r['arm']:r['execution']['outcome'] for r in rows if r['caseId']==case}
    assert len(arms)==3
    assert native(arms['current'])==baseline[case],(case,'current-parent control')
    controls+=1
    for mode,out in arms.items():
        assert out['terminal'] and not out['qualityErrors'] and out['decisions']>0
        d=out['diagnostics']
        assert d['leftSetupSpend']<=d['leftSetupBudget'] and d['rightSetupSpend']<=d['rightSetupBudget']
        assert d['previewRngUuidChecks']==d['deliveryPreviewCalls']
        assert amounts(out)==amounts(arms['current'])
        cells=set()
        for unit in out['evidence']['opening']['units']:
            assert unit['placed'] and unit['amountAlive']>0
            for cell in unit['cells']:
                key=(cell['x'],cell['y']); assert 0<=key[0]<16 and 0<=key[1]<16 and key not in cells
                cells.add(key)
        evidence=out['evidence']['sniperDonorObservation']
        for event in evidence['catalogs']:
            plans={plan['id']:plan for plan in event['catalog']}
            for retained in event['retained']:
                assert retained in plans
                if event['protectSniper']: assert plans[retained]['sniper']>=event['nativeSniper']
                if event['freeOnly']: assert plans[retained]['cost']==0
        if mode=='protect-entrant':
            pruned+=d['prunedDeliveryPlans']
            for selection in evidence['selections']:
                # Opposing native setup is unchanged and can still spend Sniper.
                protected=any(x['team']==selection['team'] and x['protectSniper'] for x in evidence['catalogs'])
                if protected: assert selection['sniper']>=selection['nativeSniper']
        scores[mode]+=out['score']
    if native(arms['protect-entrant'])!=native(arms['current']): changed.append(case)
    delta=arms['protect-entrant']['score']-arms['current']['score']
    gains+=delta>0; losses+=delta<0
    by_case.append({'caseId':case,'score':{mode:out['score'] for mode,out in arms.items()},'guardPruned':arms['protect-entrant']['diagnostics']['prunedDeliveryPlans']})
assert controls==28 and pruned>0
assert all(not c['passed'] for c in reports[0]['comparisons'])
gates={'sourceNativeColdPoolCacheFundingAndPlacementExact':True,'actualDonorPlanPruningAndPreservation':True,'higherScoreThanCurrent':scores['protect-entrant']>scores['current'],'noNewOutcomeLossesOnKnownBank':losses==0,'notWorseThanFree':scores['protect-entrant']>=scores['free-entrant']}
result={'complete':True,'passedKnownDiagnostic':all(gates.values()),'gates':gates,'sealSha256':s['sha256'],'knownCases':28,'families':14,'physicalGames':sum(reports[i]['metrics']['executedTasks'] for i in [0,1]),'logicalPerEpoch':84,'originalCurrentControlsExact':controls,'scoreTotals':dict(scores),'guardVsCurrentPoints':100*(scores['protect-entrant']-scores['current'])/28,'guardVsFreePoints':100*(scores['protect-entrant']-scores['free-entrant'])/28,'gains':gains,'losses':losses,'changedCases':changed,'prunedPlanPreviews':pruned,'freshStrengthFamilies':0,'terrainRecheckEnabled':False,'defaultChanged':False,'interpretation':'Exposed reused development diagnosis only; score does not establish independent strength. Any continuation requires separately registered fresh current-v12 study and independent confirmation, both score and overall-average+10% cost gates. No rescue or extension of earlier failed terrain/root-mixture studies.','cases':by_case}
with (p/'result.json').open('x') as file: json.dump(result,file,indent=2); file.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='cases'}))
